visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-04-03
Patient: 34-year-old man, established patient.
Chief complaint: low back pain radiating to the leg
History: low back pain for 10 weeks, radiating below the knee. Naproxen and a home exercise programme for 9 weeks without improvement.
Examination: straight-leg raise positive; ankle reflex reduced on the affected side.
Assessment: lumbar radiculopathy.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
Electronically signed by the treating clinician, 2026-04-03.
